lines.text: After the tribulation, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall.
They will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds, and He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds.
When the fig tree's branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that winter is near.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus' words will never pass away, and only the Father knows that day or hour.
A man going on a journey put each servant in charge of a bag of silver and told the doorkeeper to keep watch.
